INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (pipeline, started_at, status)
       VALUES ($1, NOW(), $2) RETURNING id

SELECT records_meta FROM pipeline_runs
      WHERE pipeline = $1 AND status IN ('completed', 'completed_with_warnings')
        AND NOT COALESCE(records_meta->'audit_table'->'rows' @> '[{"metric":"write_skipped_pre_write_warn"}]'::jsonb, false)
      ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1

WITH own_last_completed AS (
       SELECT started_at FROM pipeline_runs
        WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status IN ('completed', 'completed_with_warnings')
        ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
     )
     SELECT p.id, p.pipeline, p.status, p.started_at
       FROM pipeline_runs p
      WHERE p.pipeline = ANY($1::text[])
        AND p.status IN ('running', 'crashed')
        AND p.started_at > COALESCE((SELECT started_at FROM own_last_completed), '-infinity'::timestamptz)
        AND ($2::integer IS NULL OR p.id <> $2::integer)
      ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
